thread:
sarah-finance: Hey @mike-travel — I just uploaded the dinner receipt from the London product meetup (attached). Total £312.45. The restaurant split the bill: £200 charged to the corporate card, £112.45 to my personal card. Need to file the reimbursement.

mike-travel: Thanks — that was 5 people total (3 vendors + 2 Redwood). The corp card declined on one terminal so Sarah swiped her personal to finish. All line items are on the receipt but not itemized by person. Do we need an attendee list?

jess-ops: Yes please include a short attendee list and who was paid by which card. Also flagging: there was a bottle of wine on the ticket (merchant line: "wine bottle £45"). Policy reminder: client entertainment can include alcohol but needs manager approval if over policy limits.

ben-corpcard: Can you confirm which ledger/expense code you want charged to Redwood? Is this "Client entertainment" or "Sales meeting"? If it's client entertainment, it goes to GL 6401.

sarah-finance: Attendees: Mike T (Redwood), Jenna (Vendor), Omar (Vendor), Sarah F (Redwood), Priya (Redwood). Cards: corpcard charged £200; Sarah personal charged £112.45. Merchant breakdown (copied from receipt):
```
The Kings Table - 03/02/26
5x mains £250.00
Wine bottle £45.00
Service charge (20%) £17.45
Total £312.45
Charges: CORP XXXX-1234 £200.00; VISA XXXX-5678 £112.45
```

jess-ops: Okay, @laura-eng can you approve the client portion? Since vendors were present we need to confirm vendor portion is allowed. If any of the £45 wine should be disallowed, finance will prorate. @laura-eng

laura-eng: Approved :thumbsup: I'm fine with client entertainment for the vendor meetup. Confirmed attendees look right.

expensebot: ExpenseBot: Receipt parsed, flagged: alcohol line detected (> £40). Manager approval required — present. Missing fields: 'expense split explanation' and 'currency conversion proof' (if you want RR to use bank FX).

sarah-finance: Thanks. For currency conversion — the corp card statement shows the GBP -> USD conversion on the transaction date; do you need a screenshot of the bank FX or will Ramp use the card conversion?

ben-corpcard: We normally use the card-posted USD amount from the corp card for GL. For the personal card reimbursement we will convert using the bank rate on the transaction date; if Sarah prefers we can accept the personal card's bank screenshot. Either is fine, just attach the proof.

jess-ops: Action items for Sarah: 1) attach the scanned receipt (itemized one you uploaded), 2) add attendee list and note that corp card covered £200 of total, 3) attach bank FX screenshot if the personal card converted differently. Then submit via Ramp under expense type "Client entertainment" and code GL 6401. Finance will prorate vendor vs Redwood share and exclude any non-business amount if needed.

sarah-finance: Got it — uploading the bank screenshot now and will include a short note in the Ramp submission: "Corp card paid £200 for shared table; personal card covered remainder due to terminal decline. All attendees listed."

mike-travel: Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turn. :pray:

expensebot: ExpenseBot: Reminder — please submit within 30 days to avoid currency fluctuation manual adjustments.
